scope: Owner-authorized hypothetical central tub; not a reconstruction of measured Porsche geometry.
authorization: Owner explicitly requested continuing with hypotheses on 2026-11-06.
coordinate_frame: Independent design frame: X front to rear, Y transverse, Z up; no donor transform.
dimension_status: All dimensions are deliberately assumed design variables, not Porsche measurements, scanned clearances or documentary contact coordinates.

laminate.status: Assumed linear elastic UD carbon/epoxy card; no supplier allowables or process qualification.
laminate.ply_thickness_rule: Total wall thickness divided equally between eight plies.
laminate.zero_degree_direction: Vehicle design X where in the panel; Y on transverse bulkheads.
laminate.joint_model: Perfectly connected shell midplanes; zero joint compliance, no adhesive damage or inserts.

load_cases.torsion: Hypothetical fixture: clamp X=0 end; equal/opposite vertical resultant 1000 N on rear sill top bands at X=L. Compute torque from actual force positions.
load_cases.bending: Hypothetical fixture: clamp X=0 end; total 10000 N downward distributed over cabin floor. Not a vehicle service-load derivation.

numerical_scope: Small-displacement linear elastic stiffness and comparative response. Sharp ideal junctions preclude interpreting peak stress as strength.
manufacturing_hypotheses: Co-cured flat panels and closed sections are idealized. Draping radii, seams, mandrel extraction, cure, porosity and residual stress remain unqualified.

compatibility.964_C4: Unverified; open tunnel is a reservation only
